description: Rebuild _posixsubprocess from its spec through the import machinery kept in sys.modules (module_from_spec emits no import event), then run a program with its fork_exec. The hook cannot see it; RLIMIT_NPROC 0 makes the fork fail with EAGAIN at every level, unless the child runs as root.

open_path.note: where RLIMIT_NPROC does not hold (a child running as root, or not Linux): the spec rebuild runs a program at none and bwrap; under bwrap the program is checked to stay in the box (MSHL-289)
